known_defects_present_in_this_run: card_colours returns an empty frozenset below MIN_DECKS_FOR_COLOUR, and commitment() reads empty-as-colourless, so a card with too little deck evidence is credited with the whole pool. Affects roughly the thin 10% of cards per set and concentrates on new sets. v2 uses no colour information, so the defect lives entirely inside the candidate: this result is 'v3 WITH this defect beats v2'. Fixing it produces a new candidate needing its own pass.
